render.optics: exact sphere/cylinder intersections, vector Snell refraction, Fresnel, finite real stop, finite M1
render.scene: analytic cabinet and book boxes, synthetic monochrome printed textures, diffuse direct + ambient lighting
render.imageCorrection: horizontal digital mirror flip only; no image squeeze, perspective rectification, denoise or sharpen

note: Ray reach at default aligned books; not OCR accuracy. Signal span includes geometric blur; not a readable pixel count.

positionOptimization.definition: minimum singular value of d(native sensor pixel x,y)/d(spine mm x,y), central differences 0.1mm; minimum over actual book-spine samples; counts sampling, not resolved line pairs or OCR accuracy

search.scope: symmetric X=0 camera, mirror axis parallel shelf width; same lens/sensor/stop and 580x52 mirror
search.constraints: mirror/chassis at least 5mm above 250mm books, 4mm from roof/front/back envelope; full 760x250 spine rectangle, 1mm mirror and 10px sensor sampling margins
search.method: seeded differential evolution + bounded Nelder Mead; each density from exact sequential chief-ray finite-difference Jacobian; numerical candidate, not proof of global optimum
